summary: Quadruped (four legs and a tail) idle, walk, trot, sit, loaf, pounce, paw, eat and meow clips, with launch/contact markers.
setup: Play them from an Animator: animator.play(Assets.clips.quadruped_idle) or "clip": "clips/quadruped_idle" in an animation graph. They retarget onto any quadruped skeleton by bone name.
